# R4.1 — round-4 hygiene: context-economy row tools, ac5/G5-1/G5-7 records, helper-spawn detection

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/150_R4.1__round4-hygiene.md` (seq 150,
round-4 row 3 of 50; kind: ticket). **Requirement ids:** BM-ORIENT-01,
BM-LEDGER-08, BM-TEST-01, G5-1, G5-7, AGENTS.md gotchas 1/10, BL-41
class. **PR:** #149. **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-r4.0` — the
chain tip (operator merges; mergePolicy: OPERATOR). **Layer:**
engineered — offline-only; no live stage; production mutations: none.

## What

Round-4 hygiene infrastructure so later workers in this round (SWE-2,
256k, no compaction) read build memory and the spec at row/section
scope instead of loading hundred-kilobyte registers whole — plus the
three named reconciliations from R4.0/R3 (G5-7, G5-1, the
saturated-helper class).

- **`scripts/bm-row.sh`** — one build-memory row per id: `DF-*`
  (DEFERRALS.md), `BL-*` (BACKLOG.csv header + line), `OQ-*`/`CF-*`/
  `RK-*`/`SD-*`/`ADR-*` (research registers), `R-2.x.y`
  (COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv header + line). `--status` prints
  `id | lead token | last dated marker` (≤400 chars); `--bl` prints
  the BL home; unknown class or missing row → exit 2. Pure bash/awk.
- **`scripts/deferrals-open.sh`** — the owed index: one line per DF
  row whose status is not DONE/WONTFIX — 19 rows on this tree, the
  exact GATE-G5 §B named set (15 CARRY + 4 ACCEPT; hand cross-check in
  `runs/R4.1.md` — the count itself is not pinned). Status detection is
  gotcha-8-correct: cells split on `|` *outside* backtick code spans
  and the rightmost status-token-led cell governs, so the
  DF-S1.17-1/DF-S1.25-1 inline-`|` rows parse correctly; dated
  discharge markers (`**DONE** — YYYY-MM-DD` etc.) discharge the row.
  `--bl` lists open BL rows (`id | status | title`, ≤120 chars) — 14
  on this tree.
- **`scripts/spec-section.sh`** — one `### <sec> R-…` section
  (heading through the line before the next `###`), one `AC-…` bullet,
  or a `§heading` section (leading-0 padding accepted); unknown
  anchor → exit 2.
- **`scripts/check-bm-tools.sh`** — the invariant self-test
  (BM-TEST-01 — no living-record pins), wired into `ci.yml` as a step
  next to `check-drift.sh`.
- **Tool-first read rule** — AGENTS.md gotcha 1 and the `## Build
  memory` bullet now point workers at the row tools; the LEDGER
  `OPERATING MODE` says the same. The replaced OPERATING MODE wording
  is archived byte-for-byte at
  `docs/build/reports/ledger-archive/operating-mode-2026-10-20-pre-R4.1.txt`
  with a sha256 pointer comment in the LEDGER head (BM-LEDGER-08).
- **ac5 (G5-7)** — the merged-state derivation-aware predicate
  verified closed over the measured-wall cascade:
  `assembly_ms{value, measured_at}` on `context.assembled` →
  `derived_from.view_hash` on later assemblies (`context_view` hashes
  every prior observation-row payload) → `plan_id` (the content
  address over `derived_from{seq, view_hash}`), admitted only under
  present `measured_drift`. Enumerating members derivable from a
  measured wall closes the class — no further member is
  content-addressed over an observation-row payload; the diff loop
  still visits every difference. Dated in-test reasoning + a dated
  reconciliation note appended to the G5-7 flag in
  `docs/build/readouts/GATE-G5.md`.
- **Helper spawn (gotcha 10)** — `check-removability.sh` wraps the
  `helper_live` legs in `run_helper_leg`: on a failing leg whose
  captured output carries `helper socket never appeared` (spawn
  deadline) or `helper connect:` (connect deadline), the script prints
  the override recipe (`HH_HELPER_SPAWN_DEADLINE_MS` /
  `HH_HELPER_CONNECT_DEADLINE_MS`) verbatim and records the captured
  log path under `target/check-removability/` before propagating the
  leg's exit. Contract defaults 10 s / 5 s unchanged
  (`hh-env/src/helper.rs` untouched).
- **G5-1** — the 51-vs-7 validator warning delta root-caused and
  recorded: no tested invocation reproduces 51 (this tree reports 0
  violations / 7 warnings — the seven aggregated classes); the likely
  causes are a transient tree, a different cwd, or a miscount. Dated
  record in
  `docs/build/planning/2026-10-20_round4-decomposition.md` §Accounting.
  No defect in this repository; `~/agent-skills` never touched.
